kurz: Yoghurt drained in a cloth turns overnight into a creamy fresh cheese: labneh.
bild_im_kopf: Like coffee in a filter: the liquid runs through, the thick part stays behind.
ergebnis: About 250 g of labneh and 250 ml of whey (as a guide).
haltbarkeit: About a week in the fridge; longer shaped into balls and kept in olive oil.
verwendung: With olive oil, za’atar and bread.
Instead of cream cheese on bread, in dips and sauces.

schluesselmomente.warum: Salt seasons and draws out more [[molke|whey]].

schluesselmomente.schritt: Let it drain in the cloth over a bowl in the fridge
schluesselmomente.warum: The [[joghurt|yoghurt]]'s protein network holds on to fat and protein; the whey drips through.

schluesselmomente.schritt: After 6–8 hours: Greek yoghurt. After 24 hours: spreadable labneh
schluesselmomente.warum: The more whey is gone, the firmer it is and the longer it keeps, because less free water remains.
